## Explicitly unreachable full cases

- binary depth greater than 4: The current schema has no recursive message path; this is not a full-message vector. Source: encoding.md 2.6.
- Full Auth request exceeding its proof-field scan bound: The profile prefix already rejects before the later method-specific envelope limit; standalone envelope limits are separate substages. Source: proofs.md 1.3; limits.md 4.
- Accepted full envelope with a 128-byte registered payload type: No current registered type has that length; the scan boundary remains a profile substage. Source: envelope.md 2.
- Manifest size_overflow after all preceding checks: The global chunk-reference count times the per-chunk size bound is below u64. Overflow witnesses are standalone accumulator substages. Source: limits.md 3; manifest.md 10.
- Accepted current signed document with nonempty required_features: This revision implements no required features; nonempty legal names pass only the earlier name, sorting and profile substages. Source: manifest.md 7; descriptor.md 5 step 8.
- Full field values at the 128-byte scan bound when semantic length is fixed below it: The exact semantic length is smaller than the scan limit. These boundary cases are explicitly profile-only, with separate exact-length semantic cases. Source: limits.md 1 item 10; corresponding message field tables.
